technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish (50/200 EMA cross, price above 200-day) but intermediate trend weak with price below key moving averages, negative MACD, and low ADX; confluence insufficient for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 74 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — small to moderate amounts, junior-to-mid member
sentiment.summary: Mixed sentiment with modest congressional buying (Ro Khanna, 91-99 days ago) and market fear (32 Fear/Greed score) suggesting contrarian buy opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 94.6 crisis level, rising DXY, NFP event today) creates severe headwinds for ACN; earnings in 74 days adds moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure remains bullish (price above 200-day EMA, 50/200 SMA cross, Psar/Supertrend/OBV bullish) with contrarian congressional buying and fear-zone sentiment offering asymmetric upside if macro stress abates.
debate.key_bear_argument: Intermediate trend is broken (price below 21/50 EMA, negative MACD histogram, RSI neutral at 48.99, ADX weak at 21.49), macro environment is in crisis (VIX 94.6, inverted yield curve, NFP event today), and no active strategy triggered—creating unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
